## A - Exam authority, Section Twelve Driver Safety

This dossier supports first-time never-licensed applicants preparing for the regular noncommercial Class C written knowledge test in California. The issuing authority is the California Department of Motor Vehicles. Handbook facts in this section come from Section Twelve of the California Driver's Handbook, covering self-evaluation, reexamination triggers and process, priority reexamination, and license restrictions. The official question count, test format, time limit, and passing standard are not stated on the assigned pages, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy.
